# Community Guidelines

Welcome to the Jeninnet.Localization community!  
To keep this space helpful, respectful, and productive for everyone, please follow the guidelines below.

---

## 💬 Be Respectful and Supportive
- Treat all members with kindness and professionalism.
- Assume good intentions and be patient with newcomers.
- Avoid disrespectful, aggressive, or dismissive behavior.

---

## 🧠 Stay On Topic
- Keep discussions relevant to Jeninnet.Localization.
- Use the appropriate Discussion category (Q&A, Ideas, Debugging Help, etc.).
- For unrelated topics, please use the General category.

---

## ❓ Ask Good Questions
When asking for help:
- Provide clear context and describe what you are trying to achieve.
- Include code samples when possible.
- Share environment details (OS, .NET version, etc.).

---

## 💡 Share Constructive Ideas
- Suggest improvements with clear reasoning.
- Be open to feedback from maintainers and other contributors.
- Understand that not all ideas can be accepted, but all are welcome.

---

## 🐞 Report Issues Responsibly
- Use GitHub Issues only for confirmed bugs.
- Provide steps to reproduce, expected vs. actual behavior, and relevant logs or code.

---

## 🤝 Collaborate with the Community
- Help others when you can.
- Share examples, best practices, or workflows.
- Celebrate contributions from other members.

---

## 🔒 Follow the Code of Conduct
All interactions must comply with the repository’s `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`.  
Harassment, discrimination, or abusive behavior will not be tolerated.

---

## 📢 Maintainer Notes
- Maintainers may moderate discussions to keep the community healthy.
- Off-topic or inappropriate content may be moved or removed.
- Repeated violations may result in restricted participation.

---

Thank you for helping us build a positive and collaborative community around **Jeninnet.Localization**!
